column1: # DeskNotif partition layout for Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.28 (16 MB flash
# Layout: dual-OTA (2 x 3 MB app slots) + ~10 MB LittleFS for assets/animations.
# A previous bring-up mistakenly flashed LittleFS to 0x310000 (= app1) and
# corrupted the OTA slot. Always use `pio run -t uploadfs` (which honours this
# table) — never manually pass --address for the FS image.
